body:
Discovered during the independent review of #445 / #440. This is a pre-existing, non-blocking P3 behavior outside the additive catalog change.

On an existing current-format store that does not yet contain a newly shipped model seed, offline preflight can reject GG_DEFAULTS naming that model even though ordinary startup accepts and inserts the missing seed. That false failure can mislead an operator or block a readiness script before the first upgrade restart.

Source evidence at e63e4948e0f1813eda4cab37fa639d1d2d53bcd3:
- [Offline catalog read](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/e63e4948e0f1813eda4cab37fa639d1d2d53bcd3/apps/api/src/preflight.ts#L324) uses stored rows; [default-model membership](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/e63e4948e0f1813eda4cab37fa639d1d2d53bcd3/apps/api/src/preflight.ts#L223) rejects a missing model.
- [Startup admission](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/e63e4948e0f1813eda4cab37fa639d1d2d53bcd3/apps/api/src/container.ts#L196) projects missing shipped seeds before validation, then seeds them during startup.

The offline command's read-only policy is intentional and must remain. A stored-only catalog requirement is not documented; documentation describes a failed check as needing correction before execution.

Acceptance:
- Reproduce with a disposable current-format store missing a newly shipped seed, and process defaults naming that seed.
- Offline preflight's model-admission result agrees with startup's projected catalog without writing or seeding the store.
- Preserve existing stored-row precedence and disabled/unknown-model refusals.
- No migrations, configuration writes, or provider turns. Database bytes, stored rows and any existing WAL remain unchanged; SQLite readers may create/update `-shm` and create an empty `-wal` beside a WAL-mode store that had none, without writing frames or stored data. [D186 evidence-based clarification](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/issues/448#issuecomment-7061732566).
- Add focused positive/negative public-command evidence and update preflight documentation if needed.

Evidence status: source-only review, not a new live reproduction. No owner store, credential or service was accessed. Open/closed preflight, seed and default-model issues were checked; #179 concerns CLI capability checks, #427 account-level model refusal, and #305 is a broader umbrella, not an exact duplicate.

Delivery: parked follow-up (backlog), qa:touched-systems. Implementer GPT-6.1 Sol xhigh, opposite-family reviewer Claude Opus 5.5 xhigh; independent QA to be assigned at dispatch. Do not expand #445 to implement this, and do not close this issue without owner instruction.

## Intent 4 delivery admission — November 21

Admitted after [intent 3 engineering delivery](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/issues/279#issuecomment-7059784448) on signed main `02351e2fb932b3be44e7cc3fb3943a61d568226c`, under the owner's ordered batch and delegated blocker-decision authority. [D171 and its alternatives](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/issues/427#issuecomment-7059806202) distinguish coordinator selection from human plan approval. Historical parking text above remains history.

Use one pure stored-first (harness, model) catalogue projection for startup and offline preflight. Preserve disabled stored values, existing warning/refusal policy and read-only database/WAL behavior. The issue's explicit owner-only closure instruction remains; PRs use Part of.

Implementation and opposite-family review use the named routing models at xhigh. **Independent QA agent (planned):** `i4_448_behavior_qa`, a separate context and checkout; actual provider/session/build/evidence will be recorded when dispatched. GPT owns architecture; Claude Code contributes implementation, design critique, QA and adversarial review. Preserve touched-system positive/negative QA, unchanged coverage, current-head/current-target CI, fresh independent Astra MAX final audit and the three-general-scan cap. No implementation, QA or acceptance is implied by admission. Owner-only closure obligations and held460/Mac501 remain separate.

## Engineering delivered — owner closure instruction remains

[PR #551](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/551) delivered this engineering at signed merge `a60843a9050b3a203726db84f6abf1f45b8bc694`. The [existing engineering completion record](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/issues/448#issuecomment-7066439830) retains its review, QA, CI and evidence limits.

This issue stays OPEN under its existing instruction that the owner controls closure. [D218 queue reconciliation](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/issues/279#issuecomment-7072118937) replaces implementation eligibility with backlog parking because the engineering is already delivered. All other routing and QA labels remain. No new owner test, approval or closure requirement is added; the admission section above is historical.
